_comment: Acceptance tolerances. Committed BEFORE any solver change and before any new mesh family was run. Derived only from the recorded regular-icosphere baseline (results/beyond_sphere/baseline.json) and from textbook error estimates. Do not edit to make a check pass: if a check looks wrong, explain why in docs/beyond_sphere_progress.md and leave the number alone.

geodesic.definition: D = diameter of the surface (pi for the unit sphere, half the rectangle diagonal for the torus); h = mean edge length; errors are over all vertices for one source.
geodesic.rationale: On the baseline icosphere (levels 2-6, source = vertex 0) MAE/D = 0.074 * (h/D)^0.7 and Linf/D = 0.16 * (h/D)^0.7 to within 8%. The tolerance is that fit times 1.5: a new mesh family passes if it is no more than 1.5x worse than the regular sphere at the same relative resolution.

heat_mode.definition: u0 = analytic eigenmode with rate lam; implicit Euler to time T with dt ~ h^2. a = <u, u0>_M / <u0, u0>_M; lam_eff = -ln(a) / T; residual = ||u - a u0||_M / ||u0||_M.
heat_mode.rationale: Implicit Euler with dt = h^2 has relative rate error lam*h^2/2; a second-order spatial scheme adds about lam*h^2/12. The bound lam*h^2 leaves roughly 1.7x headroom. It is meaningless (>= 1) for modes the mesh cannot resolve, which is intended.

structure.nullspace: exactly one eigenvalue below 1e-8 * lam_1; second eigenvalue within 10% of the analytic lam_1 at the finest two resolutions

reference_self_check.note: wrapped-distance formula vs brute-force image minimum; atan2 vs arccos great-circle formula away from the antipode

performance.equal_accuracy: optimised and baseline distance fields differ by <= 1e-8 in max norm on every benchmark mesh, and every acceptance verdict is unchanged
performance.win: counted as a win for a metric (setup time, per-query time, peak memory) only if the median improves by >= 20% and the min-max ranges over the repeats do not overlap; a metric counts as a regression if its median worsens by > 5% with non-overlapping ranges
performance.note: A negative result is acceptable. No mesh is dropped from the comparison.
